variants.prompt: From the lesson section “Understand what each technique changes”: match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Quantization
pairs.detail: Represents weights, activations, or both with lower precision.
pairs.explanation: Represents weights, activations, or both with lower precision. The design includes granularity, scale and zero-point rules, calibration or training, accumulation precision, packing, and backend support.

pairs.label: Pruning
pairs.detail: Removes individual weights, blocks, channels, heads, layers, or other structures.
pairs.explanation: Removes individual weights, blocks, channels, heads, layers, or other structures. Structured removal is easier for dense kernels to exploit; unstructured sparsity needs specialized execution.

pairs.label: Distillation
pairs.detail: Trains a separate student using labels plus teacher logits, hidden representations, attention, or task-specific signals.
pairs.explanation: Trains a separate student using labels plus teacher logits, hidden representations, attention, or task-specific signals. Student architecture and loss weights are new modeling decisions.

pairs.label: Factorization
pairs.detail: Approximates large matrices or tensors with smaller factors.
pairs.explanation: Approximates large matrices or tensors with smaller factors. Rank controls the quality and compute trade-off, while factor shapes must map efficiently to the runtime.
